itens.trecho: Português O melhor filme de gangsters de sempre Este filme conta a trajectória da família Corleone e do seu líder, o "padrinho" Don Vito. Rica, poderosa e socialmente bem colocada, esta família lidera um dos mais importantes cartéis criminais de Nova Iorque como uma das "cinco famílias" da Máfia.

The Godfather Review by Al Carlson The Godfather is a film considered by most to be one of the greatest ever made. From The American Film Institute to as voted by users on the Internet Movie Database (IMDB) it is consider to be one of the best.

While I'm writing this, The Godfather is still beloved by people who love it simply because they are told they have to love it. It's written by a mobster with the sole intention of depicting the lead mobsters as demi gods.
